verdict.stance: Overweight / Fortress-Capital CEE Banking Champion (Positive Outlook)
verdict.summary: Standout CEE banking credit combining 17.8% CET1 (+2.9pp organic 9M generation), 19.9% 9M26 Adj ROE (24.7% Q3), and falling Stage 3 NPLs (3.2%). Moody's revised outlook to Positive (Baa1 dep / Baa3 sr) in Jul-26 following Luminor acquisition agreement; $1.4bn USD Tier 2 curve offers rare IG/crossover spread.

positives: Fortress CET1 capital of 17.8% at 3Q26 with exceptional organic capital generation (+290bp in 9M26) and 24.7% Q3 ROE.
Improving asset quality: Stage 3 ratio down 30bp YTD to 3.2%; manageable 74bp 9M26 cost of risk.
Geographic diversification across CEE (Hungary, Bulgaria, Croatia, Slovenia, Serbia, Uzbekistan, Baltics via Luminor) + Moody's Positive outlook (Jul-26).
negatives: M&A execution & capital consumption from Luminor Holding acquisition (Baltics) plus prior Uzbek/CEE expansion.
Elevated windfall/special bank taxes in Hungary and Ukraine plus residual Russian/Ukrainian subsidiary exposure.

background.business_overview: Leading independent CEE banking group headquartered in Budapest (HUF 48.9tn assets), operating in 11+ CEE/CIS countries.
background.asset_perimeter: OTP Bank Hungary, DSK Bulgaria, SKB/Nova KBM Slovenia, OTP Croatia/Serbia, Ipoteka Bank Uzbekistan, pending Luminor Baltics.
background.ownership_governance: Listed on Budapest Stock Exchange; widely held institutional base (MOL/public).
